description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Build privacy and anonymization systems for an AI infrastructure team, helping make sensitive real-world data safe and useful for model training and evaluation. You will develop end-to-end methods that protect sensitive information while preserving the structure and signal needed by downstream workflows.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build systems to detect PII, quasi-identifiers, credentials, and other sensitive information, and apply transformations suited to each data type and use case.

 - Develop and benchmark detection approaches combining rules, statistical models, classifiers, and LLM-based methods.

 - Create production pipelines that anonymize raw data before processing, training, evaluation, or synthetic data generation.

 - Develop evaluation frameworks for privacy risk and retained utility, including recall-weighted metrics, leakage tests, and adversarial re-identification attempts.

 - Design robust systems that handle new data sources, schema drift, unusual formats, and sensitive information in unexpected fields.

 - Work with engineering, research, operations, and customers to turn privacy requirements into practical safeguards.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 2 years of experience building production data or ML systems in Python, with strong proficiency in the language.

 - A background in a technical field and hands-on experience detecting, removing, or transforming PII while preserving useful data characteristics.

 - Experience with information extraction, named-entity recognition, classification, or related approaches for identifying rare or sensitive content.

 - Experience building end-to-end data processing pipelines and benchmarking methods across recall, precision, latency, cost, and data utility.

 - Knowledge of redaction, masking, pseudonymization, anonymization, and synthetic data generation.

 - Experience handling schema drift, unusual data formats, and edge cases; familiarity with privacy-enhancing techniques such as differential privacy, k-anonymity, secure aggregation, or format-preserving encryption is valuable.

 - Experience with low-latency or high-throughput ML systems and sensitive data in areas such as healthcare, finance, or security is beneficial.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: $130,000 to $225,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available.


LOCATION

On-site in San Francisco, California.
